assumptions: Original effective P/V/T weights frozen at published coefficients, including the audit's Ar 3% cold-pressure sensitivity; diagonal and residual-scaled, with shared scale covariance unresolved.
Local standard errors condition on the recorded row selection, fixed/adopted parameters and pressure-coordinate reduction; calibration systematics and cross-row correlations are not propagated.
Residual-scaled estimates assume independent residuals with common variance after any frozen weighting. They are not published parameter uncertainties or a recovered author error budget.
Student-t intervals, where supplied, are marginal local approximations, not exact nonlinear or joint confidence regions.
Source error confidence is retained as reported (including Dewaele's 95% intervals); missing confidence remains unknown and no new combined-two-sigma flag is inferred.

primary_source_check.finding: Both source-owned fits are experimental; older experimental and calculated literature rows in Table 1 are comparisons, not new fits. BM3 with K0_prime fixed 4 plus constant linear thermal pressure.

primary_data_check.finding: All 59 high-temperature observations. No reliable room-temperature lattice parameters or volumes: the 300 K reference curve and V0 are extrapolations, not measured ambient cotunnite properties. All coordinate and lattice errors retained; confidence convention, fit weights, covariance and raw calibrant readings unreported.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Table 1, p.750; Methods, p.751; Equations 1–3, p.754; Figure 7, p.754; Supplemental Table 2.

reference_isotherm.V0: Table 1 p.750 and EOS text p.754: 24.75(0.06) cm^3/mol of ThO2; multiply by 4e24/N_A for conventional Z=4 cell. Fitted extrapolated value.

thermal_correction.alpha_KT: Table 1 and Equation 3 p.754: fitted constant product alpha*K_T in GPa/K, not constant alpha and not Debye MGD.
